verdict.rationale: Kit's official remote MCP server gives an AI client read/write access to live account data, including subscribers, sequences, broadcasts, tags and segments, and the V4 API covers campaign results well. That includes per-broadcast stats, per-link clicks, batch stats for a page of broadcasts, 90-day account email stats, growth stats, and 5-year email stats retention. Together these let an agent pull audiences and recent campaign performance and report on what's working. Missing for 10: evidence that live visual automations (beyond sequences) can be read via the API/MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven reporting.
